readings.explanation: This pole fires at a low near-ceiling baseline (about 0.17) on ordinary high-frequency English continuation tokens — common auxiliaries, verbs, nouns, infinitive 'to', and whitespace/punctuation — when the current token is predictable from fluent left context, driven mainly by the current token itself; strength drops when the current token is rare, surprising, or non-English.
A content-free default-on background unit that sits near 0.17 on essentially every token regardless of frequency or language, so rare-word and non-English swaps cause no systematic drop.

A narrow English auxiliary and infinitive-marker detector for was/are/to/be, where noun and whitespace peaks are only spillover from neighboring function words, so isolated common nouns should not activate it.
